Bajaj EMI on Amazon

6 steps to buy using a Bajaj EMI Card

Use these reference screenshots as a visual guide. The exact checkout screens and available plans may vary by account, product and time.

Step 01

Select the computer set

Open the relevant Amazon product link, select quantity and tap Buy Now or Add to Cart.

Step 02

Choose card payment

At payment, open Credit & Debit Cards and choose the option to add/select your eligible card.

Step 03

Enter card details securely

Follow Amazon's secure payment instructions. Never share your card number, CVV or OTP with anyone.

Step 04

Select Bajaj Finance

If your eligible Bajaj EMI card is available, select it from the supported payment methods.

Step 05

Choose an EMI plan

Review the available tenure, monthly instalment, fees and total payable amount before selecting the plan.

Step 06 – Final

Review and place order

Check delivery address and order total. Confirm payment only after verifying the final EMI details.

Important: These are general guidance steps, not a guarantee that every Bajaj EMI card or every product will qualify. Use only the official Amazon checkout. Do not send card credentials, CVV or OTP over WhatsApp or to the seller.
Need to know

Frequently asked questions

Can I order from anywhere in India?

Yes. Free home delivery across India is stated for these offers. Confirm serviceability for your PIN code on the Amazon product page.

How can I purchase on Bajaj EMI?

Open the product on Amazon and check the payment page for eligible Bajaj Finance EMI options. Availability and tenure depend on Amazon, the card and the transaction.

Are the monthly EMI amounts fixed for everyone?

No. The amounts shown are indicative. The final EMI and any fees or applicable charges shown at Amazon checkout take precedence.

What is covered under warranty?

The offer states 1 year service-centre warranty on the 19-inch LED monitor and 1 year on CPU processor, RAM and SSD components.

What can I use this desktop for?

Billing, study, office work, browsing and basic productivity tasks. Software and gaming performance depends on the exact configuration and application requirements.

Can I ask Bitsweb Computers before ordering?

Yes. Tap WhatsApp Us to ask product or order-related questions. Never share card details, CVV or OTP in chat.
